text:
zoe: Scheduling the monthly admin-entitlement prune for next Wed AM. There's an open triage on CVE-2026-210 for billing-worker and Okta is doing a user-sync this week. Thinking we need a combined pre-check before enabling. Thoughts?
ops-bot: SCHEDULE: admin-prune job queued for 2026-06-02T08:00Z (job id prune-2026-06-02)
hashim: +1 on pre-checks. Suggests: 1) audit-log freshness < 10m, 2) no critical vuln tickets mapped to a candidate role, 3) no KMS key rotations in last 36h, 4) last-authn > 72h for users, 24h for svcacct.
emily: Also require a fast KMS smoke decrypt for svcacct principals before prune: `kms:decrypt --key=redwood-prod-svc --payload=ZmFrZQ== --timeout=800ms`. If decrypt fails or times out, mark candidate for manual review. Also add an audit event for each prune decision with event_id so we can unprune automatically.
pager-bot: ALERT: open vuln CVE-2026-210 affecting billing-worker (ticket SEC-10321). Role billing-admin currently attached to the infected service.
zoe: ok block prune for any candidate whose role intersects with SEC-10321 until triage is resolved. Also add a 'triage-block' tag to the candidate so reports show it.
hashim: let's make the audit event schema explicit. Proposed sample:
```json
{
  "event": "prune.decision.v3",
  "candidate_id": "role:billing-admin|svc:billing-worker",
  "decision": "flagged_manual",
  "gates": {"audit_fresh": true, "kms_smoke": false, "vuln_block": true},
  "reason": "KMS smoke decrypt timed out; vuln SEC-10321 mapped"
}
```

emily: Nice. We'll store event_id in the prune index and wire an automated revert: `prunectl unprune --event-id=$EVENT_ID` which restores bindings and creates an incident note. Also add metric entitlement.prune.manual_interventions and entitlement.prune.auto_reverts.
ops-bot: CANARY: started canary run (20 candidates) in staging. Command: `prunectl run --canary --count=20 --check-kms --check-vuln --audit=true`.
ops-bot: CANARY RESULT: 3/20 candidates flagged for manual review (2 KMS fails, 1 vuln-block). Report: https://internal/reports/entitlement/canary/4281002222
zoe: Good signal. Please update the runbook: include steps to run `prunectl --dry-run --annotate=SEC-10321` and verify audit sink emitted events. Also include post-run monitor: auth-proxy errors >0.8% for 15m -> auto-unprune and page oncall.
sec-bot: INFO: audit-sink now accepts prune.decision.v3 schema and stores event_id trace for 90 days.
emily: I'll open PR with config + runbook + rollback automation: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR/1102 "entitlement: prechecks (auditsync/kms/vuln) + auto-unprune playbook". Will add dashboard tiles for entitlement.prune.manual_interventions.
hashim: schedule cross-team dry-run with security+infra+prod-ops and confirm Okta sync window. Also ensure we don't run during deploy blackout windows.
zoe: thanks all — pausing job until dry-run passes and SEC-10321 shows triage-block cleared. I'll update job state.
